rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Miniature.
Registration name: POUlcot
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, before 1983). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, before 1983).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 1983 as 'Patio Flame'.
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S in 1990 as 'Apricot Midinette'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot - orange. Mild fragrance. 20 petals. Small, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, arching, spreading. Glossy, leathery foliage.

Height: 6'7" (200cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden or pillar. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Notes: An apricot counterpart to the world famous 'Cecile Brunner'.
